name: Kharadi
summary: A suburb in north-east Pune on the Mula-Mutha river, between Viman Nagar and Wagholi. It is one of the city's main eastern office hubs.
knownFor: World Trade Center Pune, the city's only WTC
EON IT Park, with offices of firms such as Barclays and Zensar
connectivity: Kharadi bypass links Hadapsar to the Pune-Ahmednagar highway
Keshavnagar-Kharadi bridge, opened Aug 2026, connects to Mundhwa side
suits: Professionals working in Kharadi's IT and business parks who want to live close to the office.
